title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(柳橋秀幸研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Yanagibashi Hideyuki)
keywords: Biological Information 2.Behavior Control 3.Magnetic Fluid 4.Magnetic Measurement 5.Regional Collaboration
educationalGoal: Study theme is life science based on electrical and electronic engineering, and will actively collaborate with local farmers and companies. The aim of this course is to help students improve abilities to problem finding and its solution, data processing, academic writing, presentation, communication, etc. In addition, students learn the significance of interdisciplinary science and preciousness of nature, and use it for character building as engineer who is active in society.
advice: Students assigned to this laboratory are divided into groups and conduct study activities on the project themes throughout a year. Activity status is reported through study diary and weekly report. Project theme example 1. Relationship between electrophysiological properties and morphogenetic properties of mushroom fruit body 2. Behavior of bio-electric potential and morphogenetic properties to stimulation on mushroom hyphae 3. Non-contact measurement of plant bioactivity using magnetic fluid Activity flow First Semester: Students acquire knowledge and equipment operation through literature surveys, and conduct experiments. Students present the results of the period at the end of the semester. Second semester: Students continue the project activities. Students write project report and present it at public examination meeting. Students take over of project works to next year students.
requiredKnowledge: 1. Teamwork 2. Electronic circuit 3. Electromagnetism 4. Measurement and control 5. Biology

activityGoals.body: Be able to clarify the purpose and the content of your study and develop a study plan.
Be able to promote study with sufficient communication with laboratory members.
Be able to solve problems and issues in study yourself.
Be able to summarize the study results in a project report.
Be able to explain about your study and present the results effectively.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Clarify the study purpose and identify study problems. Propose solutions and study safely according the plan. (2) Properly analyze, consider, evaluate, and discuss the study results. Summarize them as a project report, and present them effectively. (3) Condense the study results and publicize them through conference and academic paper.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand and explain significance, purpose, problem and application of your project theme. (2) Perform your project based on the plan, and design and manufacture equipment as necessary. (3) Show the results at public examination meeting and related societies effectively.
